description: The finished report. Call it first with failedOnly: true: results, total, nextOffset and text then cover only the pages that failed, while summary still covers every page. Without it, a slice of every page's result (offset and limit, default 50 a call, at most 5000; nextOffset points at the next slice) and the plain-text report over that slice. limit: 1 returns the summary with one result. Free.

failedOnly.description: Only pages whose status is fail: results, total, nextOffset and text then cover the failed pages alone, while summary still covers every page.

jobToken.description: The jobToken returned when the job was created. Optional when the request carries the prepaid key that paid the job (Authorization: Bearer dck_…).

limit.description: Page results to return (default 1000, at most 5000).

offset.description: Index of the first page result to return (default 0).

name: get_report
title: Get report
